# Coverage: JOURNEYS

**6 / 6** invariants in this zone have at least one covering test (**6** verified in the per-PR gate; the rest run nightly — _(nightly)_ below).

| ID | Invariant | Covered by |
|----|-----------|------------|
| INV-JOURNEYS-01 | OAuth sign-in completes the full browser round-trip — clicking "Sign in with Google" from an unauthenticated context navigates `→ /auth/google/start → mock-OIDC authorize → callback → minted session cookie → back to the authenticated app shell` as the seeded user, the one path session-injection can't cover. The redirect chain and the cookie hand-off are exactly what the handler tests stub, so this is the only place the loop is verified intact. Mirrors, never re-owns, AUTH's handler halves (INV-AUTH-02 state/CSRF, INV-AUTH-03 session cookie, INV-AUTH-05 founder bootstrap); a break here strands every user at the door. Verified in `login.spec.ts` (runs the local mock-oidc provider, ADR-0024 option B — never contacts accounts.google.com) | `frontend/e2e/login.spec.ts` |
| INV-JOURNEYS-02 | Record snapshot is one honest button in the browser — on a position detail page the snapshot toolbar offers a single **Record snapshot** (no Copy carryover, no New). It opens on the month after the latest snapshot with an empty amount and a "Last recorded" line whose **Same as last month** fills the amount while leaving the statement date blank; picking a month that already has a value shows the replace notice and the prefilled value *before* save, and saving replaces that month (one row, not two) with a toast whose **Undo** restores the earlier value, never a `SNAPSHOT_MONTH_EXISTS` error. The browser face of INV-SNAPSHOTS-12 (which owns the rules) and #788. Verified in `snapshot.spec.ts` | `frontend/e2e/snapshot.spec.ts` |
| INV-JOURNEYS-04 | A first-time Google identity onboards through the gate in the browser — a sign-in whose `google_sub` matches no user navigates `→ /auth/google/start → mock-OIDC authorize → callback` and, finding nothing to sign into, records a handshake and lands on the `/onboarding` gate (not the app shell); the founder choice then bootstraps the Household + real session and the authed shell renders as the brand-new founder. The browser sibling of INV-JOURNEYS-01 (which lands as the *existing* seeded user) for the new-identity branch. Mirrors, never re-owns, AUTH's gate halves (INV-AUTH-05 handshake/redirect-instead-of-bootstrap, INV-AUTH-13 founder commit); the mock issues a per-run-unique unseeded `sub` via the `mock_oidc_sub` cookie (mockoidc.go, #274). Verified in `onboarding.spec.ts` (local mock-oidc, ADR-0024 option B) | `frontend/e2e/onboarding.spec.ts` |
| INV-JOURNEYS-03 | Import preview→commit→list parity in the browser — feeding an exported position workbook through the list-screen Import dialog: the dry-run check reports **no errors and a would-create** (writing nothing), and only the explicit commit creates the position, which then appears in the list. The end-to-end UI face of INV-IMPORT-01 (preview/commit parity, dry-run no-op); IMPORT-01 owns the server contract, this owns the dialog's check→commit→reflected-in-list loop including the export→re-import file round-trip. Verified in `import-create-roundtrip.spec.ts` (bank-account workbook; `investment-import-create-roundtrip.spec.ts` is its investment twin) | `frontend/e2e/import-create-roundtrip.spec.ts` |
| INV-JOURNEYS-05 | Bulk monthly-entry saves and reflects in the browser, for every amount-only group — "Enter this month" (from the group's Home for Assets/Liabilities, or the list toolbar for the flat Receivable group) lists an eligible position with its carried-forward prefill and a live changed-count; typing a value marks the row dirty and ticks the count, and Save all commits the dirty rows and returns to the group. Re-opening the same month proves the batch persisted: the row now carries this month's own value and warns the next save overwrites it. The browser/journey face of INV-SNAPSHOTS-06 (dirty-only atomic save) and INV-SNAPSHOTS-07 (carry-forward surfacing); those own the server contract and its unit-level face, this owns the list→edit→save→re-open loop the non-technical monthly-update user actually walks, across Asset/Liability/Receivable. Verified in `bulk-monthly-entry.spec.ts` (one @smoke per group) | `frontend/e2e/bulk-monthly-entry.spec.ts` |
| INV-JOURNEYS-06 | Deleting a snapshot needs no confirm dialog and is reversible in the browser — the row menu's Delete removes the snapshot at once and raises one toast with **Undo**; clicking Undo brings the very row back (the month reappears in the table). The browser face of INV-SOFT-DELETE-06 (the server's single-row undo) and INV-PRESENTATION-17 (no dialog, one Undo toast). Verified in `snapshot.spec.ts` | `frontend/e2e/snapshot.spec.ts` |
